epics.name: Ratify the bounded compatibility contract before code
Implement and verify the shared identity boundary
Integrate start resolution and fidelity without bypasses
Prove integration and produce a conditional operator handoff

issues.title: Amend requirements and living log for receipt-bound native roles and fail-closed resolution
issues.detail: Amend `skills/yf-plan/spec/phases.md` REQ-PLAN-077 for both native wrapper types and actual-gate-only mutation; amend `skills/yf-plan/spec/data.md` REQ-DATA-026 to preserve existing issue/edge checks and add explicit gate identity semantics. Allocate REQ-DATA-077 for the versioned role receipt, provenance limits, complete/incomplete states and historical attestation policy; allocate REQ-PLAN-087 for normalized role classification and refusal behavior. Update `skills/yf-plan/spec/cli.md` and CLI requirement/test inventories for `record-execution-roles` and diagnostic receipt arguments, including resolver nonzero INCONCLUSIVE. Add the plan-074 entry in `SPEC.md` before implementation. Use references/compatibility-contract.md as the reviewed proposal, not as already effective SPEC. No global landing-order requirement is changed by this issue.

issues.title: Add pure role classification and native positive/adversarial tests
issues.detail: Implement `_shared/gate_roles.py` and `_shared/test_gate_roles.py`. Normalize native list/show representations, enforce exact distinct role IDs/root/fingerprint/evidence binding, parent/blocks/await predicates, competing roles and complete-input checks. Accept genuine 1.1.0 task and 1.3.1 gate forms. Retain raw fixtures from this bundle in supported test fixture locations with byte/hash manifests, label all derived mutations synthetic. Cover every adversary in the compatibility contract, including copied topology without provenance and closed wrapper/open real human gate. No graph-writing or consent authority exists in this module.

issues.title: Retain native execution role receipts and explicit historical imports
issues.detail: Add `record-execution-roles` to `skills/yf-plan/scripts/plan_manager.py` and `skills/yf-plan/scripts/test_execution_roles.py`. Persist exact pour/create evidence, start-only/finalized receipt states, plan/root/fresh fingerprint binding, idempotence and atomic validated writes with readback; conflicting writes refuse. Historical import requires explicit provenance acceptance and never fabricates native origin. Test immutable PIM copies with the supplied mapping, plus stale/foreign/conflicting/missing-acceptance cases and zero writes on refusal. Retain actual authority separately; no acceptance file is created by tests in a live bundle.

issues.title: Use proven roles for actual-gate resolution and postcondition checks
issues.detail: Replace `_find_start_gate_pair` title/type and generic Gate fallback with complete gate-inclusive acquisition and shared classification. Update `resolve-start-gate` to preserve existing fresh-session approval checks/caller boundaries, target only the actual human gate, re-read it before ordinary wrapper close, and re-read both before pass. Add `skills/yf-plan/scripts/test_gate_wrapper_resolver.py`: genuine task/gate positives, idempotent success, wrong-target prevention, preclosed wrapper/open human gate, CLI errors, partial mutation recovery and zero mutations under bad identity/absent authority. Never force-close or rewrite gate types. Update installed-surface SKILL prose source and affected CLI callers to handle nonzero inconclusive without advancing status.

issues.title: Compare exact real-gate identities while retaining graph safety and installed packaging
issues.detail: Integrate classifier into `_shared/pour_fidelity.py`; keep all issue/epic/duplicate and dependency checks, validate declared gate/entry/reconcile relations, and remove only the one proven wrapper from gate counts. Require finalized role receipts for completion; add read-only `--roles PATH` for explicit diagnostic evidence without hidden environment overrides. Extend `_shared/test_pour_fidelity.py` and add `_shared/test_gate_wrapper_fidelity.py` for all positive/negative boundaries, count-preserving gate substitution, incomplete snapshots, actual H0 archived red-to-green and unchanged 8/7/4 denominators. Preserve exit 0/1/2 and landing halt on both nonzero classes. Wire `_shared/sync.py`, vendored files, imports, embed/manifest and relevant SKILL/beads-authoring documentation so source, embedded and installed forms agree; test them, do not deploy them live.

issues.title: Mechanically exercise native wrapper lifecycle under sandbox HOME
issues.detail: Add `skills/yf-plan/test-harness/gate-wrapper.sh`: isolated HOME/git/bd stores, explicit tool provenance, unmodified native formula, real current bd gate-wrapper pour and authentic historical task fixture/native tool control. Drive record/resolver/fidelity verbs against the modified sandbox-installed skill. Prove exact expected IDs, gates, edges, authority/refusals, zero forbidden writes, missing/tool-error controls and cleanup. Run existing Tier-1, shared sync and required Tier-2 smoke as applicable; no interactive-agent smoke substitutes. Unknown modes, zero selected tests and missing tools fail distinctly.

issues.title: Rehearse the proposed self-hosting boundary and stop on unsafe recovery
issues.detail: Implement sandbox-only `skills/yf-plan/test-harness/gate-wrapper-bootstrap.sh` and emit `evidence/bootstrap-rehearsal.json`. Exercise every requirement in references/bootstrap-proposal.md with the actual manager paths and clearly labelled external-action intercepts. Begin with OLD installed intake and no preseeded new-format receipt; exercise B0 durable capture and supported actual-gate-only fallback, then convert those same captures with the newly sandbox-installed recorder after deployment and before fresh completion. Prove full actual changed-set inventory despite bookkeeping-only HEAD, exact final clean/synced/FULL-validated tree, pre/post binary/embedded/installed hashes and enumerated deployment surfaces without permission/config broadening. Reproduce repeated-failure journal regression as a refusal control and demonstrate no automatic replay or lost evidence. If safe recovery needs landing-engine code changes or an unsupported manual journal edit, STOP and escalate scope; no live exception is adopted merely because a simulation passed.

issues.title: Validate scoped deliverables and prepare the operator-owned landing and held-H0 handoff
issues.detail: Run the full compatibility matrix and repository validation against the actual changed tree; write `evidence/compatibility-acceptance.json`, `evidence/deployment-manifest.json` and `evidence/landing-handoff.md` with source/version/digest pins, test denominators, known limits, full changeset, bootstrap decision status and exact required later pre/post checks. Do not call missing deployment or PIM checks passed. Prepare fresh dry-run/independent lander/validated decision and stop for operator terminal apply only when rehearsal and separate authority permit. Reconcile #417 through yf-beads-upstream only after authorized verified delivery, not on a source-only green. No live deployment is an execution-bead prerequisite that would deadlock landing; actual installation/completion/PIM checks are explicitly later operator-owned obligations, not claimed by this bead.

gates.name: Start Gate (mandatory)
gates.instructions: Operator in master approves the exact reviewed plan and fresh fingerprint. Execution uses a fresh cpa/claude-opus-5-5 session; planner stops before intake/execute. Plan approval alone does not accept B1 or B2.

gates.name: Capability Gate: Explicit compatibility policy and bootstrap decisions
gates.condition: Operator separately accepted the strict role-evidence policy, B0 old-tool intake bridge and proposed B1 promotion exception against reviewed hashes; B2 remains separately required before any live PIM receipt is added. Master drafting permission is not consent.
gates.instructions: Frontload at execute start. Read the actual operator answer, verify decision identities, proposal hashes and scope; file existence never resolves this gate. If withheld or ambiguous, remain held and route questions through planner to master. A rehearsal failure prevents live bootstrap even with prior conditional acceptance.

criteria.criterion: Actual deployment and held-H0 validation remain explicit later obligations, never evidence fabricated before they run
criteria.verification: manual: operator reviews B1/B2, pre/post tool and surface hashes, fresh validated landing decision, actual installed fidelity success and unchanged PIM graph before separately resuming H0; lack of any required result leaves that boundary held

risks.risk: Wrapper closure is mistaken for human consent
risks.mitigation: Actual human gate alone resolves; re-read state; wrong-target native negative and unresolved capability-gate controls.

risks.risk: New evidence policy makes old plans silently pass or silently disappear
risks.mitigation: Explicit historical acceptance, documented INCONCLUSIVE boundary, genuine task native positive, no graph retrofit.

risks.risk: Repair cannot deploy itself under installed fidelity
risks.mitigation: UNAPPROVED B1, full disposable interrupted-lifecycle rehearsal, clean/synced exact-tree FULL validation and fresh operator decision.

risks.risk: Failed replay regresses journal and repeats outward writes
risks.mitigation: Snapshot phase boundaries; measured negative; stop rather than retry; separate scope decision if engine repair necessary.
Modified sandbox install, manifest/digest comparison, live promotion only later from synchronized main.

risks.mitigation: Immutable bundle fixtures and disposable stores; any new live receipt separately authorized; no existing PIM writes.
Only role/gate identity and relevant edges; explicit excluded follow-ups; escalate newly required engine changes.
